notes.title: Playtest Update 25-08-13
notes.content:
Greetings Playtesters!

We have some small content updates and game fixes for the [b][i]Bot Colony _redux[/i] Playtest[/b] to improve your experience:
• Updated chat avatars in the text field for all remaining oil rig bots. Now the face matches the bot!
• Updated the audio for the Hunter Bot landing cutscene. Punchier sounds, suitable for Jeff or Jennifer.
• Improved SKIP options: Skip the early cutscenes if you like. Get back to gameplay faster!
• Updates to Jennifer's sounds when taking damage. No more conspicuously male grunts for our gal.
• Fixes to sound restarting in Humanity Test. Background tunes are behaving during the interrogation!
• Pause [ESC] menu functionality returned to Humanity Test. Now you may pause to take a break from Hades' abuse!
• Looting! Yes, the much requested ammo looting has been added to game. It's unlimited for now. Fire away!

To address some player feedback, we'd like to make it clear that this Playtest build isn't set up exactly how the final level will be set up.
For example, in the Playtest there are currently no Checkpoint saves.
This means any random death sends you to the Control Room for a session of the Humanity Test.
In the real level, your mission progress will be saved after each major Objective is completed, as expected.
So if - for example - you complete the Capitalist Faction challenge, then you get smacked on your way to the next Faction (or another location), you'll be able to reload back in the safety of the Capitalist camp with all progress intact, ready to continue your mission.
We'll be implementing the full mission structure soon with Checkpoints to support it.
Thanks again for your interest and feedback!
We're aiming for a steady release schedule of new updates to oil rig content in the Playtest, and will eventually add entirely new episodes to test.

Regards,
Team North Side

notes.title: 🚀 Bot Colony redux Playtest Begins!
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome Playtesters![/h2][p]Thank you for your interest in the[b] Bot Colony _redux Playtest[/b]. For this first phase of the Playtest, we have a slice of the game's third episode for you to sample (and feedback!). This episode takes place on an oil rig in the Pacific Ocean, recently abandoned by human staff and taken over by robots![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Gameplay to Test:[/b][/h2][p]
In this smaller version of the episode we've prepared for the Playtest, you'll start by flying a Hunter Bot over the oil rig to remove some pesky sentries before landing.
After landing, you'll experience several of the early mission-related dialogue challenges that will be featured in the full game. We've enabled 11 of our bot characters for open ended conversation. Discover their personalities as you reveal the story![/p][p]
Keep your eyes peeled and your trigger finger ready, as hostile droids patrol the areas between the dialogue bots. If you get whacked by a patroller, it's not game over yet! You'll be captured and sent to the [b]Humanity Test[/b], where interrogator bots will grill you to determine if you're a flesh and blood human or a next-gen android sent to sabotage the robot rebellion. You'll have to be thick-skinned and resilient to deal with the bots' sadistic interrogation techniques![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Known issues:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]You will encounter long loading times to enter the level (still being optimized), and you will experience bugs - to be expected in any pre-release software.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Feedback:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]We urge you to post feedback and bug reports on the game's Steam forums and, if you like, please[url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2FkkyTFYNb3Q"][u] [b]join the game's Discord server[/b][/u][/url] to leave comments there.[/p][/*][*][p]Click the FEEDBACK FORM option at the game's main menu to submit test feedback directly to the team.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Testing Uptime:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]We've given each Playtest applicant a generous starting allocation of cloud resources to get started with gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]The more active you are with feedback on the forums and Discord, the more uptime we will add to your account for cloud resources to play.[/p][/*][*][p]Haven't had the chance to apply yet? Hit that green “Request Access” button on our Steam page 👇[/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3613080/Bot_Colony__redux"][/dynamiclink][/p][/*][/list][p]Additionally, we've created a helpful [url="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3513421664"][u][b]Quick Controls Guide[/b][/u][/url] to get you rolling, and inside the game you can check the HELP option in the pause menu for a complete list of controls.
Happy testing, and thanks again for your interest! Your feedback is critical to help us polish, tweak, and balance [i]Bot Colony _redu[/i]x before release! [/p][p][/p][p]- Team North Side [/p]

notes.title: 📣 Bot Colony _redux Dev Update – Visual Leap Before & After
notes.content:
[b]We are excited to share a sneak-peek into the visual transformation our game has seen over the past months and years of hard work! 🤩[/b]

[h3][b]Without further ado... [i]ta-da![/i] 🥳[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6166112/704c7785efd412b527f42443d82c3f40f99817b1.png[/img]
[b]What you see here is a 1:1 comparison of the same scene[/b], one from earlier in development, and the other a completely rebuilt version with richer atmosphere and striking details to bring our immersive storytelling to life.
This is not only a comprehensive update to models, textures, and level design, [b]it's a complete artistic reimagining powered by Unreal Engine 5.5 with a special focus on Lumen dynamic lighting[/b], which we hope you will appreciate.

This is from a brand new level previously unseen created to highlight how far we’ve come since the original Bot Colony's release. It takes place on a huge off-shore oil rig in the Pacific that you can freely explore, with huge replayability value[b]*[/b] and with our latest visual updates it's looking better than ever!
[b]*[i](you choose how to engage and interact with the NPCs and environment!)[/i][/b]

[b]We’re working hard to elevate every corner of the experience.[/b] Be it graphics, gameplay, performance, and fidelity to the world of Bot Colony. 

📢 We hope this gives you a taste of the passion going into every pixel, and [b][url=https://discord.gg/kkyTFYNb3Q]we invite you to join our Discord[/url] [/b]for first-access to Dev Updates & Game Announcements.

Thank you for being here. The road to _Redux is full of milestones, and we’re excited to bring you along. As a reminder, [b]we have a free Demo on the way[/b] and a [url=https://forms.gle/gc1Dudj62kgbxJDw7][b]Closed Beta you can apply to here[/b][/url].

❤️ The Bot Colony _redux Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3613080/Bot_Colony__redux/?beta=1

notes.title: 🚨 Big News 🚨 FREE Bot Colony _redux Demo and Closed Beta
notes.content:
Whether you're a long-time fan of the original or totally new to the world of advanced natural language interaction with robots, this is your chance to experience a taste of what's coming. The demo features the same groundbreaking vision we've always shared — now with improved tech and updated visuals, powered by Unreal Engine 5!

[h3]🧠 [b]Speak with robots, investigate mysteries and test the limits of AI conversation.[/b][/h3]
It’s all back and better than ever — now featuring an exciting collaboration between OpenAI services and our own homemade Natural Language Processing technology!

[h3]💬 [b]Join our community on Discord[/b][/h3]
Want to connect with other fans, share your thoughts on the demo, or talk directly with the dev team?

👉 [b][url=https://discord.gg/kkyTFYNb3Q]Join our Discord here[/url][/b]
We’re building an active community and would love to have you on board!

[h3]🧪 [b]Sign Up for the Closed Beta – Starts June 16![/b][/h3]
We’re also launching a closed beta on June 16 to gather deeper feedback and put the latest updates to the test.

[b]Spots are limited[/b], so if you want to be among the first to play new content and help shape the future of Bot Colony _redux:
👉 [url=https://forms.gle/YcRbYiWijNGimSeL9][b]Sign up for the Closed Beta here[/b][/url]

We are so thankful for your continued support. 
This time around, we feel we have the technology to reach the potential we've always known Bot Colony to have. 

We can’t wait to hear what you think of the demo!
[i]– The Bot Colony Team[/i]
